summary: Continued the interrupted art-characters build. On disk: the 10 characters (lumi, borron, owl, frog, ladybug, polarbear, octopus, fairy, dragon, queen) in src/art/characters/cast, shared pose/face/frame/extras/horn layers, the LumiHorn HUD, the 8 companion species with 4 colourways, and the 18 accessories in src/art/companions. stubs.tsx was already gone. This session I verified the state, checked the spec items and captured screenshots. The only code change was a row gap in Accessories.gallery.tsx so hats no longer collide with the row above. Not finished: a full pose-by-pose visual review of every gallery. Only the top part of the character gallery and the accessory grid were inspected.
publicApi: Exports from src/art/characters/index.ts: Character (CharacterProps), CompanionArt (CompanionArtProps), LumiHorn({crystals: boolean[8], size}), POSES, CHARACTER_IDS, COLORWAYS, normalizeColorway, Colorway, ACCESSORY_IDS, accessorySlot, isAccessoryId, AccessoryId, AccessorySlot.
tests: npx vitest run src/art/characters src/art/companions: 3 files, 588 tests passed before the gallery edit. After the gallery edit, npx vitest run src/art/companions: 474 passed. npm run typecheck | grep src/art/(characters|companions): zero errors.
openIssues: Visual review is incomplete. Only the top of the character gallery and the accessory grid were captured and checked. The full companion species x colourway sheet and the pose sheets still need a critical look.
Bunny default colourway is very pale lilac/white on white, which is low contrast at 48px.
The unicorn's horn overlaps wizard-hat and beanie in the accessory grid. This is a drawing issue, not just a gallery spacing one.

The screenshot tool tools/shot.mjs hardcodes a Linux Chromium path (/opt/pw-browsers/...), which fails on this macOS machine. I used a temporary copy that points at the cached chromium_headless_shell-1243 binary and deleted it afterwards. tools/shot.mjs itself is unchanged, and the fix belongs to whoever owns tools/.

Screenshots were written to /Users/mac13/Desktop/Inessa-Mat/shots/ (art-chars.png, art-companions.png, art-acc.png). That directory is new in the repo root and should be deleted or gitignored before commit.
The user sent two messages containing only image coordinate multipliers and no text. I could not tell what they wanted pointed out, so I did not act on them.
notesForOtherModules: The screenshot tool needs a macOS-compatible launch path or an env override for the Chromium binary.
